answer: timestamped content hash anchored in the epoch block is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. Cloning 479 keys multiplies the price 479-fold: 42631 POA locked, or 7664 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the dune up to the light, weigh the haven of the attack, and keep the nebula of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
